useBaseUiId(idOverride?).semantic: Wraps useId and prefixes generated ids with 'base-ui-'; an explicit override is returned as-is. Returns undefined if the override is undefined and no generated id is available in that render pass.

formIntegration: Ids generated here are what Base UI wires for label/control association (Field <-> control) and for aria-labelledby/aria-controls pairs (e.g. Tab -> Panel). Migrated custom components should use this hook rather than raw useId so SSR/client id prefixes stay consistent with the rest of the library.
notableDifferences: React Aria's useId (from @react-aria/utils) uses a different prefix/scheme. Because Base UI parts internally generate ids for aria wiring, a wrapper that hard-codes or re-derives ids from RAC will desynchronise; use useBaseUiId for any id a migrated component must generate itself.
Repo imports @react-aria/utils in exactly one place (file-upload-trigger.tsx:9, filterDOMProps — not useId), so the id-migration surface is small.
